content: Xoossi Dawites Immida Hidota
Kawozi ba kawoteththa keeththan woppu gi uttidaappenne GODAY iza yuushon diza iza morkketappe shempisidaappe guye,
nabe Naataanes, «Hekko tani zigappe keexettida kawoteththa keeththan days; Xoossa Caaqo Qaala Taabotay gidikko dunkaanen dees» gides.
Naataaneykka, «GODAY nenara gidida gishshas ne qoppida ubbaa ooththa» gides.
He gallassa omars GODAA qaalay Naataanekko yiidi,
«Neni baada ta aylle Dawites: Ta izan daana keeth ne keexxaka.
Tani Isra7eele asaa Gibxeppe kesoosofe doommada hach gakkanaas dunkaane taas aqoso histtada issisoppe haraso yuuya yuuya de7adis attiin keeththan de7abeekke.
Tani Isra7eele asaara bidaso ubbaan ta dere Isra7eele naagana mala ta azaziin kaaleththizaytappe issaa, ‹Ne taas ziga miththafe ays keexxabeekkii?› gidaadey dizee?
«Ha7ikka ta aylle Dawites Ubbaafe Wolqqama GODAY: Ta dere Isra7eele ne ayssana mala ta nena denththadis; dors heemmizasohoppe ta nena ekkadis.

Ne bidaso ubbaan ta nenara gidadis; ne morkketa ubbaa ta ne sinththafe dhayssadis; ha7ikka istta sunththay biitta bolla keehi erettida daro gita asatappe issaa sunththa mala ta ne sunththaa dhoqqisana.
Izas buzo duussasoy daana mala hayssafe qaaxxontta mala ta dere Isra7eeles soho immananne minththana. Hayssafe kase hanida mala hayssafe guye iita derey istta un7eththenna.

Ta dere Isra7eele kaaleththizayta ta shuumida wodeppe doommidi istti iza bolla ooththidayssaththo hayssafe guye iza bolla oosettenna; hessaththoka ne morkketa ubbaafe ta nena naagana. GODAY ba hu7era keeth nees keexxanayssa izi yootees.
Ne layththaa wursada kase ne aawatanne gayttiza wode nena laattana zereth ta neeppe kessana; iza kawoteththaaka ta minththana.
Ta sunththaas keeth keexxanay iza; tanikka iza kawoteththaa mernaas minththana.
Ta izas aawa gidana; izikka taas naa gidana; izi mooro ooththiko as muriza guufera ta iza murana; asa nay lisson garafettiza mala ta iza garafana.
Ta maaroteththaa neeppe kase diza Sa7ooleppe haassidayssaththo ta izappe haassike.
Ne keeththaynne ne kawoteththi ta sinththan mernaas minni daana; ne kawoteththa araataykka mernaas minni daana» gides.
Naataaney hayssa ajjuuta qaala kumeth Dawites yootides.
Dawite Woosa
Hayssafe guye kawo Dawiti geli GODAA sinththan uttidi, «Ubbaa Haariza GODAWU! Ne tana hayssas gaththanaas ta oonee? Taso asaykka aazee?
Ubbaa Haariza GODAWU, hayssi ne sinththan guuth gidishin ne gidikko ne ayllezasoy sinththafe hananayssa yootadasa; Ubbaa Haariza GODAWU! Ne asara gayttiza lose ogey hayssee?
«Dawiti nena hayssafe bollara hara ay gaana dandayzee? Ubbaa Haariza GODAWU, ne aylleza ne eraasa.
Ne qaalaza gishshassinne ne wozina qofa mala ne hayssa gita miish ooththadasa; ne ayllezi erana mala qonccisadasa.
«Ubbaa Haariza GODAWU, ne ay mala gitaa! Mulekka nena misatizay oonikka deenna; nuni nu hayththara siyida mala neeppe attiin hara Xoossi deenna.

«Ba dere gidana mala iza ashshanaas Xoossi izappe sinththara bida derey, ba sunththas ooththana mala kawoteththatanne istta eeqa xoossata ba sinththafe gooddidi gitanne yashissiza malaata ooththidi Gibxeppe wozzi ekkida ne dere Isra7eele malay biitta bolla ooni dizee?
Ne dereza Isra7eele mernaas nees buzo dere ooththada minththadasa; GODAWU, ne iza Xoos gidadasa.
«Ha7ikka GODAA Xoossawu, neni ne ayllezasinne iza keeththaas immida hidotaa mernaas naaga; ne yootida malakka pola;
hessa gishshas ne sunththi mernaas gita gidana; asaykka, ‹Ubbaafe Wolqqama GODAY Isra7eele Xoossaa› gaana. Ne aylle Dawite keeththay ne sinththan mino gidana.
«Abeet Ubbaafe Wolqqama GODAWU, Isra7eele Xoossawu, ‹Ta nees keeth keexxana› gaada hessa taas ne ayllezas qonccisadasa. Hessa gishshas ne ayllezi ha woosayo woossanaas ba wozinan xalides.
Abeet Ubbaa Haariza GODAWU! Neni Xoossa; ne qaalaykka ammanettidayssa; hayssa lo7o miish ooththanaas neni ne ayllezas hidota immadasa.
Izi ne sinththan mernaas minni daana mala, ha7ikka ne aylleza keeth anjjarkkii! Abeet Ubbaa Haariza GODAWU! Hayssa nerkka ne yootadasa; ne anjjon ne aylleza keeththi mernaas anjjettana» gides.
